 Smash Worlds debut — Dplus KIA’s Thrilling Comeback Win at LoL Worlds 2026
 Oct 24, 2026 2:39 PM PDT 
 Riot Games Flickr. 
 During the Swiss stage Round 1 of the Smash Worlds debut at the 2026 LoL World Championship held in Allen, Texas, Dplus KIA (DK) secured a dramatic, high-stakes comeback victory against G2. Trailing 0-7 early in the match, bot laner Shin ‘Smash’ Geum-jae played a pivotal role in turning the game around during his very first Worlds appearance.
 Overcoming Pressure in a Memorable Debut
 Reflecting on his first-ever international stage experience, Smash admitted that he felt unexpected nervousness despite thinking he would stay calm. Experiencing early deaths and feeling the suffocating pressure of the Worlds stage made him realize the immense weight of the tournament. Nevertheless, maintaining concentration allowed him to secure a much-needed victory for his team.
 Strategic Choice and Mid-Game Resilience
 Addressing the choice of Ziggs against G2’s Kalista-Renata Glasc combination, Smash explained that limited champion pools in the second phase of the draft led him to pick the champion as a reliable fallback. Despite a costly individual mistake that momentarily accelerated G2’s lead, he quickly refocused. Even while facing a daunting 0-7 kill deficit, the team maintained composure, recognizing that item power spikes remained close and capitalizing on G2’s overextensions around objectives.
 Building Mental Fortitude and Looking Ahead
 Credits for his unshakeable mental strength during crisis moments go to his past experiences as a trainee and in the second-tier league. Realizing that emotional frustration only harms gameplay, Smash learned to suppress panic and approach matches logically. Expressing gratitude to fans watching early in the morning, he promised to deliver even more polished and solid performances in upcoming matches.
